newsitem.title: USA: U.S.-China Industrial in distribution pact.
newsitem.headline: U.S.-China Industrial in distribution pact.

text.p: U.S.-China Industrial Exchange Inc said Wednesday it will become the sole distributor of certain Kendall healthcare products in China.

The company said it will have exclusive responsibility for the marketing, sales, importing and distributing of select products of the Kendall Healthcare Products Co. Kendall, a maker of disposable medical supplies, is owned by Tyco International Ltd.
U.S.-China Exchange officials were unavailable to comment on which products the deal covers. The company will import the supplies into its Tianjin warehouse, in the northeast of China.
